# Token reference

Every design token in `Tokens~/tokens.json` (Veilbreak v1). USS reads a token as `var(--vb-…)` anywhere, custom shape properties and `-unity-font-definition` included; code reads colours from `VbTokens`. A token marked *reference* has a CSS-only value (shadows, filters, curves) that UI Toolkit cannot hold; components apply its intent directly and the web mirror uses it as is. How to use them: [platforms](guidelines/05-platforms.md).

## Colour

Two themes. Veil is the game. High contrast is an added accessibility theme: solid panels, brighter accents, 3:1 frames. Colour always travels with a shape or a word: allies are circles, enemies diamonds, queued things hatched.

### Display (display)

Adventor Bold, always in caps, always tracked out. Titles, names and CTAs only.

| Style | Size / line | Weight | Tracking | Sample | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | 64px / 64px | 700 | 0.12em (7.68px) | VICTORY | Verdicts and summon titles. One per screen. |
| `display` | 40px / 44px | 700 | 0.14em (5.6px) | SEARCHING | Full-screen states: matchmaking, rift banners. |
| `title` | 22px / 28px | 700 | 0.18em (3.96px) | TEAM | Screen and sheet titles next to the back chevron. |
| `cta-label` | 24px / 28px | 700 | 0.2em (4.8px) | BATTLE | Label of the glowing CTA. 28px on desktop. |
| `name` | 16px / 20px | 700 | 0.2em (3.2px) | ARIA | Fighter names in cards, inspectors and the lineup. |
| `code` | 18px / 20px | 700 | 0.04em (0.72px) | AR AE MI NY | Two-letter fighter codes in rail tiles and portraits. |

### HUD (body)

Poppins with tabular figures. Numbers never jump when they tick.

| Style | Size / line | Weight | Tracking | Sample | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clock` | 28px / 32px | 600 | 0 (0px) | 0:58 | Match clock and big countdowns. |
| `numeral` | 20px / 24px | 600 | 0 (0px) | 34/100 | Power value, stat values, cooldown seconds. |
| `label` | 11px / 14px | 700 | 0.14em (1.54px) | POWER · ROSTER | Section and control labels, set in caps. |
| `badge` | 10px / 12px | 700 | 0.1em (1px) | AUTO · QUEUE | Badges and button captions, in caps. The smallest size on mobile. |
| `ui` | 13px / 18px | 600 | 0 (0px) | Fan −18 → 16 left | Live HUD text: chips, aim previews, queue entries. |

### Text (body)

No weight below Regular on mobile.

| Style | Size / line | Weight | Tracking | Sample | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | 0 (0px) | Fires three projectiles in a 12° spread. | Descriptions, item details, rule notes. |
| `caption` | 12px / 16px | 500 | 0 (0px) | Ranged · skill shots · Lv 7 | Metadata under names and values. |

### Readout (hud)

Share Tech Mono, the HUD's telemetry face, for section labels, numbers, tags and short button captions over the plum panels. Always caps for labels; numbers are monospaced so they never jump. Sentences, titles and names stay in Poppins and Adventor.

| Style | Size / line | Weight | Tracking | Sample | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `readout-label` | 10px / 12px | 400 | 0.22em (2.2px) | TACTICAL · TARGET | Panel headers in the visor (top-left of a frame, followed by a rule). |
| `readout` | 12px / 16px | 400 | 0.08em (0.96px) | RANGE 240 m · NO CONTACT | Telemetry lines, captions and button labels. |
| `readout-num` | 22px / 24px | 400 | 0.02em (0.44px) | 176 · 0:58 | Big readouts: clock, power, speed. |

Each style is `--vb-font-size-<style>`, `--vb-line-height-<style>` and `--vb-tracking-<style>` (px). TextCore reads `letter-spacing` in hundredths of an em (`18px` ≈ 0.18em), so Gui.uss writes tracking per rule; the `vb-t-*` classes (display, title, label, body, caption, num, badge, power, ally, enemy) carry the common combinations.

## Radius

Square. Corners are cut, not rounded (see Cut). Round only for world markers.

| Token | Value | USS | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-none` | `0` | *reference* | Every panel, button, chip and bar. |
| `radius-round` | `9999px` | *reference* | Only circles that mean something: ally markers, latency dots, selection rings. |

## Shadow

Box shadows are for unclipped wrappers only; cut shapes glow with the `glow-*` filters.

| Token | Value | USS | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `focus-ring` | `{'veil': '0 0 0 2px #050208, 0 0 0 4px #faeef4', 'contrast': '0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #ffffff'}` | *reference* | Keyboard focus on unclipped elements (inputs, sliders). Cut shapes use the focus frame instead. |
| `lift` | `{'veil': '0 16px 40px -12px #000000e6', 'contrast': '0 0 0 2px #faeef4cc'}` | *reference* | Popovers, sheets and the character popup over the scene. |

## Cut

Cut corners, top-left and bottom-right only. The two square corners carry the brackets.

| Token | Value | USS | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cut-sm` | `6px` | `--vb-cut-sm` | Chips, item cells, queue chips, small tiles. |
| `cut-md` | `10px` | `--vb-cut-md` | Buttons, ability buttons, rail tiles, panels. |
| `cut-lg` | `14px` | `--vb-cut-lg` | Large panels, sheets and the main CTA. |

## Glow

Filters for cut shapes (a box-shadow would be clipped). Glow budget: the CTA and the selected thing. Off in High contrast and Reduce flashing.

| Token | Value | USS | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `glow-cta` | `drop-shadow(0 0 14px #1dd9a08c)` | *reference* | The one CTA per screen. |
| `glow-ally` | `drop-shadow(0 0 10px #1dd9a073)` | *reference* | The selected fighter and the aiming ability. |
| `glow-power` | `drop-shadow(0 0 10px #c084fc66)` | *reference* | A queued ability firing at its mark; the Power strip while filling past a mark. |
| `glow-enemy` | `drop-shadow(0 0 10px #f0509a66)` | *reference* | Rejected actions and incoming signature telegraph labels. |
| `glow-gold` | `drop-shadow(0 0 18px #f6c86e80)` | *reference* | Legendary reveals only. |
| `text-halo` | `0 1px 3px #000000b3` | *reference* | text-shadow for any text sitting directly over the 3D scene (world labels, combat text). |

## Fx

Sci-fi HUD effect parameters. Every effect is subtle enough to switch off without losing information.

| Token | Value | USS | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scan-pitch` | `3px` | `--vb-scan-pitch` | Scanline period on holo surfaces. |
| `scan-alpha` | `0.03` | `--vb-scan-alpha` | Scanline opacity inside panels (the `scan` colour). Never above 0.08; 0.03 since 2026-10-23, when the flat original-design panels took back a faint layer of the visor glass. |
| `hatch-pitch` | `6px` | `--vb-hatch-pitch` | Period of the queued and danger hatch (2px line, 135°). |
| `grid-pitch` | `24px` | `--vb-grid-pitch` | Holo floor grid and menu backdrop grid. |
| `bracket-length` | `8px` | `--vb-bracket-length` | Arm length of corner brackets on the square corners. |
| `chroma-offset` | `1px` | `--vb-chroma-offset` | Red/cyan split on holo text during the flicker-in. 0 with Reduce flashing. |
| `holo-tilt` | `6deg` | *reference* | Maximum pointer-parallax tilt of 3D menu panels, and the visor wrap's steepest keystone. 0 with Reduced motion. |
| `grain-alpha` | `0.04` | `--vb-grain-alpha` | Film grain over menu backdrops only; never over the battle HUD. |
| `visor-curve` | `0` | `--vb-visor-curve` | Visor wrap: how much taller a panel's outer edge is than its inner edge at the screen edge (fraction of its size, never more than `visor-keystone-max`). Panels at the centre stay square. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-keystone-max` | `8px` | `--vb-visor-keystone-max` | Cap on the visor wrap's outer-edge growth, so big sheets do not lean. |
| `visor-fringe` | `0px` | `--vb-visor-fringe` | Red/blue split of the projected UI at the visor corners (grows with the square of the distance from centre). 0 with Reduce flashes; desktop tiers only (M_VisorFilter.mat). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-bloom` | `0` | `--vb-visor-bloom` | Strength of the projector bloom the visor filter adds around bright strokes and text. Desktop tiers only (M_VisorFilter.mat). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-bezel` | `0px` | `--vb-visor-bezel` | Depth of the helmet bezel at the top corners of the view (board units). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-barrel` | `0` | `--vb-visor-barrel` | The visor's barrel curve, shared by the camera (VisorLensFeature), the UI (VisorFilter) and input (VisorLens): the centre is magnified by 1 + this, the rim compressed, the four corners fixed. Desktop tiers only; 0 (flat) on the mobile tiers. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-falloff` | `0` | `--vb-visor-falloff` | How much the projected UI dims toward the visor rim (0..1). Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-focus-blur` | `0px` | `--vb-visor-focus-blur` | Focal blur radius of UI toward the rim and away from the pointer (the eye follows the pointer). Board units at full defocus. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `visor-focus-fringe` | `0px` | `--vb-visor-focus-fringe` | Extra red/blue split of defocused UI (toward the rim, away from the pointer). Board units at full defocus; 0 with Reduce flashes. Off (0) since 2026-10-23: the screens are flat panels again, as in the original designs. |
| `loader-turn` | `60` | `--vb-loader-turn` | Degrees the icosahedron loader turns counter-clockwise each time an edge finishes lighting. |
